title: 04 Tumbletree: playful illustrated footer with a meadow and a mascot
strengths: The link panel is a good object: a rounded white card with a thick ink border and a hard shadow, four columns with a coloured dot per group
Pip has a pose and a line ('See you tomorrow!') and the kite gives the scene a diagonal; the ink outline and the sticker buttons share one drawing rule
Palette is clean: sky, two greens, yellow, tangerine; Fredoka plus Nunito is a sensible two-face pair
slop_signals: 'big curiosity.' in a yellow highlight block inside the headline
Two sticker buttons and then three check-mark pills ('No ads', 'No in-app buying', 'Made with teachers'): the hero stack placed in a footer
Stock scenery: four lobed clouds, a semicircle sun with a glow, two 'm' birds, lollipop trees; the shapes every kids template ships
Pip is the round-blob-with-eyes-and-blush mascot; no detail says Tumbletree rather than any app
Tiny white dots scattered on the grass as 'detail'
fixes: Remove the highlight block and the check pills; keep one button
Give the scene one specific idea: Pip's kite string tied to the link panel, or a lesson card in Pip's hand; cut the clouds, sun and birds
Make Pip particular: the sprout is the start; add one odd feature (a satchel, one tooth, a stripe) so the mascot is ownable
Draw the grass as one flat shape; drop the scattered dots

references.what: A line-art street scene along the bottom edge with characters doing things, plus a hand-drawn email field with a bird; the scene has stories, not shapes
The mascot as a huge photographed plush cropped by the green band, links tiny; one object, enormous
A painted landscape as the ground with the link grid in bordered cells above; our panel-over-scene follows this
Links set directly over a painted sky with the landscape below; no buttons in the footer
Pencil sketches along the bottom as the reward for scrolling; playful without a template

changed: Removed the meadow, sun, clouds, birds, trees, kite, speech bubble, the mascot, the highlighted headline, both buttons and the check pills
Rebuilt as a quiet index on a flat night ground: wordmark, two factual paragraphs, four link columns with lesson counts and a total of 1,036

One detail only this brand has: a handwriting-formation specimen of the first eight Phase 2 phonics sounds (Set 1 s a t p, Set 2 i n m d) on four writing lines, with yellow used only for start dots, first-direction arrows and stroke numbers
Neutral white-alpha text (7.5:1) and rules; one accent with one job
Layouts checked at 1440, 1240, 1100, 960 and 390 px; phone frame re-rendered

facts: placeholder mark removed and the about text cut to one line (both from the final audit, checked by eye)
